entities.name: Erythrina falcata
observations: Stem-bark extracts and flavonoid-rich fractions were tested in rat aversive-memory paradigms.
Active fear-memory constituents reported include vitexin, isovitexin, and diosmetin-6-C-glucoside.

entities.name: Vitexin
observations: Purified from Erythrina falcata; enhanced acquisition/retention of conditioned fear memory in rats and later underwent extinction.

entities.name: Isovitexin
observations: Purified from Erythrina falcata; enhanced acquisition/retention of conditioned fear memory in rats and later underwent extinction.

entities.name: Diosmetin-6-C-glucoside
observations: Purified from Erythrina falcata; enhanced acquisition/retention of conditioned fear memory in rats and later underwent extinction.

entities.name: Erythrina falcata FfB
observations: Flavonoid-rich stem-bark fraction; influenced fear-memory acquisition and spontaneous recovery in conditioned-suppression testing in rats.

entities.name: PMID:25096710
observations: Primary rat study titled Flavones from Erythrina falcata are modulators of fear memory.
Extracts, fractions, and purified vitexin, isovitexin, and diosmetin-6-C-glucoside enhanced conditioned-fear acquisition/retention; some fractions increased resistance to extinction.

entities.name: PMID:26778988
observations: Primary follow-up study of Erythrina falcata flavonoid-rich fraction FfB in rats using conditioned suppression.
FfB altered fear-memory acquisition and spontaneous recovery; implicated GABA-A, GluN2B-NMDA, 5-HT1A, and ERK-related hippocampal mechanisms.

entities.name: E falcata fear modulation
observations: Direct aversive-memory evidence shows that Erythrina falcata flavonoid preparations and three purified flavones modulate acquisition, retention, extinction resistance, or spontaneous recovery in rats.
Evidence does not establish a fear-memory effect for erythrinin or erythrinine specifically.
Available excerpts do not provide reliable dose values.
